name: Sasazuka Takeru
source:
A hacker who previously worked for the Cyber Crimes Division at HQ. He quit after a few months for personal reasons. He's exceptionally smart and skilled, though he's self-centered, brusque, and is always looking for some way to use people to his advantage.

Sasazuka doesn't trust others easily and also has a strong dislike of guns due to past events in his life. In mild contrast to his harsh exterior, he's got a pretty serious sweet tooth.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
